option_definitions.routine: normal or expected, no action needed
option_definitions.attention: a real issue a human should review soon, but not urgent and nothing is actively failing or dangerous
option_definitions.escalate: urgent: active failure, danger, or security breach needing immediate action

method: identical prompts via SelectiveModelBackend; cold first call measured separately; warm latency = median over 3 hard-case passes; accuracy graded on pass 1 only

d3:lite.note: FLM refuses to chat-serve d3 models ('d3:lite is a decision model: serve it with flm serve --decision d3:lite ... and POST /v1/systemone'); graded through the selective pattern (rules first, systemone on unsettled) with the frozen spec's option_definitions as choice criteria. Returns a native probability distribution + confidence per verdict.

pick_reason: highest selective accuracy on the frozen case set, then lowest warm median model latency (HG-T2 rule)
